simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַרְיֵה (H745) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אַרְיֵה (ʼAryêh) means Arjeh , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 15 25.

definitions.full: H745. Aryeh אַרְיֵה proper name, masculine so apparently 2Kin 15:25 an officer of Pekahiah, but with article הָאַרְיֵה , & on text with possible corruption & dittography see Klo.
